_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-22. CardID = 17600 + idx; 304 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 4). The deck object holds 31 cards (the 30 plus the character card). Sherlock's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's and the rest: only deck.identity (data/tts/sherlock-holmes.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card (read from the image): SHERLOCK HOLMES, MELEE, START HEALTH 16, MOVE 2; ability 'Effects on HOLMES and DR. WATSON cards cannot be canceled by an opponent. (Effects on ANY cards can be canceled.)'; sidekick DR. WATSON, RANGED, START HEALTH 8, move 2 (unmatched-memory agrees).

Bands read from the images: SHERLOCK HOLMES on The Game is Afoot, Deduce Strategy, Counterpunch, Elementary, Master of Disguise, Confirm Suspicion and Eliminate the Impossible; DR. WATSON on Service Revolver, Fixed Point in a Changing Age and Administer Aid; ANY on Study Methods, Education Never Ends and Feint. Order on the sheet: Game is Afoot 0-1, Service Revolver 2-3, Deduce Strategy 4-6, Counterpunch 7-9, Study Methods 10-11, Education Never Ends 12-13, Feint 14-16, Fixed Point 17-18, Elementary 19-20, Master of Disguise 21-22, Confirm Suspicion 23-25, Eliminate the Impossible 26-27, Administer Aid 28-29.

Discrepancy with unmatched-memory (the card wins): Feint reads IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card (unmatched-memory files it under DURING). Everything else (titles, copies, type, value, BOOST, 30 cards, texts) agrees with the images.

Sherlock's Feint (idx 14-16, band ANY) is word for word Medusa's, Doctor Strange's and Pandora's: the three Feints carry the tag `sherlock` so that two equal Card values in two decks of one sheet never exist (tests/test_card_identity.py). Nothing reads the tag.
